scope: First kill tests only. These refute proposed bridge mechanisms, not Erdős #809.
evidence_level: author-verified natural proof or exact inherited computation

kills.certificate: Let repeated colours be c1,c2 with legal sets Q(c1)=Q(c2)={q1}. Let the global reserve be {q1,q2}, set D_B=E_0=2 and f=1. Then |Q|=D_B and E_0<=4f(D_B-1), but |Q({c1,c2})|=1<2. Thus total reserve and scalar mass inequalities do not imply subfamily Hall inequalities.
kills.leaves_open: Graph geometry could force additional incidence constraints not present in the inherited scalars.

kills.certificate: The inherited automatic-two-label theorem makes every colour graph an induced matching, and a t-edge colour class realizes all 2^t endpoint words by independent edge flips. The audited sharp cores have g repeated 2K2 colours and defect D_B=g while preserving the two-label condition.
kills.leaves_open: Labels augmented by fixed endpoint/reserve provenance remain viable.

kills.certificate: For the unrooted graph K2, let tau swap its endpoints. If an orientation were canonical and automorphism-equivariant, tau would preserve the chosen oriented edge. But tau reverses the only orientation, a contradiction. A geometric root external to the colour graph is necessary.
kills.leaves_open: Maximum-witness geometry may supply a precommitted root, but the colour graph alone cannot.

kills.certificate: Take two selected stars s1,s2, one repeated colour ci on si, and one common legal token q with Q(c1)=Q(c2)={q}. Each star separately has one token for one colour, while their union has two colours and matching number one. Starwise cardinality does not compose without cross-star subfamily inequalities.
kills.leaves_open: A laminarity or disjoint-budget theorem could make starwise expansion composable.

kills.certificate: The energy E(a,h,u,T) depends only on scalar graph coordinates. Decorate one fixed feasible scalar profile with either Q(c1)={q1}, Q(c2)={q2} or Q(c1)=Q(c2)={q1}, leaving (a,h,u,T,D_B,|Q|) unchanged after adding unused q2. The first incidence has an SDR and the second does not. Therefore scalar energy by itself cannot imply Hall; a graph-specific incidence lemma is indispensable.
kills.leaves_open: A reserve-decorated energy retaining subfamily rank could still work.

kills.certificate: Fix any radius R and choose m>2R+2. System A is the disjoint union of an alternating path P_(2m+1) with both endpoints colours and an alternating P_(2m+1) with both endpoints tokens. System B is the disjoint union of balanced alternating paths P_(2m) and P_(2m+2). Both have 2m+1 vertices on each shore. Their multisets of rooted radius-R neighbourhoods agree: each has two endpoints of each shore, identical nonoverlapping boundary rays, and the same number of deep degree-two roots of each shore. B has a colour-saturating matching in each component; A fails Hall on its colour-ended component. Hence no fixed bounded-radius density list determines Hall in unrestricted incidence systems.
kills.leaves_open: An unbounded hierarchy or a theorem imposing special global structure on graph-generated incidence systems remains possible.

kills.certificate: Take three colours, each uniformly supported on {q1,q2}, and add unused reserve token q3. Every marginal token entropy is one bit and total reserve size equals D_B=3, but the three-colour union has size two and admits no injection. Marginal entropy plus total capacity does not imply Hall.
kills.leaves_open: Conditional entropy inequalities for every subfamily would merely restate a rank/Hall condition and may still be useful if graph geometry proves them.

kills.certificate: For t>=2 colours with identical singleton legal support {q}, the natural token-competition graph is K_t, so its chromatic number is t and its matching number is floor(t/2), while the reserve union has size one. Large conflict complexity measures collision; it does not supply capacity.
kills.leaves_open: A capacitated bipartite flow representation, rather than an uncapacitated colour-conflict graph, remains viable.

statement_match: All certificates concern only the stated bridge claims. None constructs or excludes an n-vertex rainbow-C7 extremal graph for all n.
